name: memkit
description: Injects pointers to your own memory files into every prompt: lexical retrieval over a tiered markdown store, plus a checker and an eval for it.

memkitConfig.title: memkit config file
memkitConfig.description: Absolute path to the JSON config naming your memory stores. The plugin is inert until this file exists, and writing it is manual in this build — the schema and a worked example are in the project README under Config. An init command will create it at the default path below in a later release. Nothing is read from your machine before then.
